Title: The neurogenic bladder: medical treatment
Abstract: The current experience with compounds other than @CHEMICAL_oxybutynin @CHEMICAL_MESH:C005419 @@@oxybutynin@@@ is still limited in children with @DISEASE_Urinary_Bladder_Neurogenic @DISEASE_MESH:D001750 @@@<m>neurogenic</m> <m>bladder</m>@@@. <m>Botulinum</m> A <m>toxin</m> injections into the <m>detrusor</m> muscle have been shown to be a potentially valuable approach in the @DISEASE_Urinary_Bladder_Overactive @DISEASE_MESH:D053201 @@@<m>neurogenic</m> <m>overactive</m> <m>bladder</m>@@@.
